name: Ningbo Kangnex WJ500V-5.08-2P 2-way 5.08 mm PCB screw terminal block (KF301-2P)
//: The 2-way 5.08 mm screw terminal LaskaKit sells (LA217015A), made by Ningbo Kangnex Electric Co., Ltd - the 'KF301-2P' of a thousand kits. The maker's single-sheet drawing for the WJ500V series is served by LaskaKit; its spec table states IEC 250 V / 18 A (UL 300 V / 15 A), wire 30-14 AWG / 2.5 mm², contact resistance 20 mΩ, insulation 500 MΩ at DC 500 V, withstand AC 2000 V for 1 min, -40 to +105 °C, torque 4.08 kgf·cm / 0.4 Nm / 3.54 lb·in, strip length 6-7 mm, M2.5 zinc-plated steel screw, tin-plated brass body and pins, PA66 UL94V-0. Read 2026-09-29 while researching the irrigation controller's 12 V inlet, for the 'or a 2-way screw terminal' half of the need. Rails are named as that design names them.
//why_not: Not passed over on merit - it carries the load nine times over - but the inlet was decided as a barrel jack for a wall adapter; this is the record to promote if the supply arrives as bare wires.

power.note: Position 1. A terminal block has no polarity; which position is + is a decision printed on the silkscreen and nothing else.
Position 2. The supply's return; the star point belongs here.

//pin_order: Two identical positions; pad 1 = VIN is a convention this record sets, not a property of the part. Mark it on the silkscreen.
footprint_note: pinrow2 is a 2.54 mm pitch; the drawing's 'RECOMMEND PCB LAYOUT' is two Ø1.20±0.05 mm holes on a 5.08±0.10 mm pitch. footprinter takes a pitch parameter (pinrow2_p5.08mm) that was not tried here.

body_mm.why_it_matters: Read off the series drawing: length N x 5.08 ±0.20 (10.16 mm for N = 2), depth 10.00±0.20, height 14.00±0.20 with 4.50±0.20 mm pins. The wire enters from the side and needs room beyond the board edge; every placement is arranged around it.

host_requirements: No polarity: print + and - on the silkscreen at the block, because the block will not.
Stranded wire under a screw needs a ferrule or it frays into the neighbouring position at 12 V.
Side entry: leave clearance beyond the board edge for the wires and a screwdriver above.
Fuse after it; 18 A of contact will not protect a 2 A rail.

rated_current_iec_a.note: Spec table on the maker's drawing sheet: 额定电流 IEC 18A; the LaskaKit listing states '18A'.
rated_current_iec_a.why_it_matters: Nine times the irrigation board's load; the block is not the limit, the wire and the fuse are.

rated_voltage_iec_v.note: Spec table: 额定电压 IEC 250V; listing '250V AC'.

rated_current_ul_a.note: Spec table: UL 15A; the moulded marking reads '300V 10A' - the sheet and the body disagree, and neither matters at 2 A.

pitch_mm.note: Listing 'rozteč 5.08mm'; the drawing's N x 5.08±0.20 and title block '间距5.08MM' agree.

positions.note: The '-2P' of the part number; the drawing is the N-pole series sheet.

hole_diameter_mm.why_it_matters: Read off the drawing's PCB layout (Ø1.20±0.05); the footprint's drill.

pin_thickness_mm.why_it_matters: Read off the drawing (0.80±0.05 by 0.90±0.05 pins, 4.50±0.20 long); must pass the 1.2 mm hole.

sourcing.note: '5 Kč' s DPH, '4,10 Kč' bez DPH; 597 ks skladem. The listing states 18A, 250V AC, rozteč 5.08mm, 2 kontakty, zelená, and links the maker's datasheet.
